en.headline: Government launches consultation on Building Management Ordinance reforms
en.dek: Proposals include higher attendance and voting thresholds for large-scale works, limits on proxy votes, and stronger powers for the authority; views are invited until 11 September.
body: The government today opened a one-month public consultation on proposed amendments to the Building Management Ordinance. Officials said the changes aim to raise owner participation, improve transparency in major decisions and better protect owners’ interests after the Wang Fuk Court fire heightened concern over building management.

Five main directions are set out: higher attendance and in-person voting thresholds for large-scale maintenance and high-value procurements; reforms to the proxy-instrument system, including caps on the number of proxies any one person may hold; improved declaration-of-interest rules; expanded powers for the authority; and clearer meeting procedures.

Among the detailed suggestions are a requirement that resolutions on certain high-value procurements obtain the personal votes of at least 5 per cent of owners or 100 owners, whichever is lower, and limits so that in buildings with more than 50 units a proxy holder may represent no more than 20 owners or 2 per cent of the total. The consultation document is available on the Home Affairs Department website; submissions close on 11 September.

zh.headline: 政府就《建築物管理條例》修訂展開公眾諮詢
zh.dek: 建議提高大型維修及大額採購的出席和投票門檻、限制授權票數量，並加強主管當局權力，諮詢期至9月11日。
body: 政府今日就《建築物管理條例》修訂建議展開為期一個月的公眾諮詢。當局表示，建議旨在繼2024年修訂後進一步深化改革，提升業主參與度和決策透明度，更好保障業主權益，並回應宏福苑大火後社會對大廈管理的關注。
修例涵蓋五大方向：提高大型維修工程及大額採購的出席及投票門檻；完善委任代表文書制度；完善利益申報制度；加強主管當局權力；以及清晰會議程序。
具體建議包括對部分大額採購增設親自投票門檻，要求決議獲不少於業主人數5%或100名業主親自投票；以及為每人可持授權票設定上限，單位超過50個的大廈每人不得超過單位數目的2%或20份。諮詢文件已上載民政事務總署網頁，公眾可於9月11日或之前提交意見。
